'''2008 Wyoming State Championship''' was a ''Star Wars'' CCG state championship played on Sunday 17 August 2008 at Slackers, 211 S 1st St, Laramie, Wyoming, with [[Regis Michelena]] as tournament director.<ref name="sf-21794-314451">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=314451#p314451 Wyoming States 2008!], Kizakh (Regis Michelena), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (11 July 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref> Ten players took part.<ref name="sf-21794-327348">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=327348#p327348 Wyoming States 2008!], quesosauce37 (Jerry Heine), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (18 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref> [[Brian Hunter]] went undefeated, and [[Thomas McGee|Tom McGee]] took the bye to Day 2 of the [[2008 World Championship]] after conceding the final confrontation.<ref name="sf-21794-328147">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=328147#p328147 Wyoming States 2008!], AnakinSolo, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (19 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="sf-22883-332133">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=332133#p332133 List of People who have Worlds Day Two Auto Bids 2008], simone89, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (29 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125194535/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t22883.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Site:''' Slackers, 211 S 1st St, Laramie, Wyoming<ref name="sf-21794-314451" /><ref name="sf-21008-303347">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=303347#p303347 Road to Worlds - Western US - All West States Events/Plans], CategoryOneGames.com, Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 May 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125190718/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21008.html Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''Dates:''' 17 August 2008<ref name="sf-21794-314451" />
* '''Time:''' 10:30 am (doors open at 10)<ref name="sf-21794-314451" />
* '''Entry fee:''' $10<ref name="sf-21794-314451" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Regis Michelena]], with the three-judge system<ref name="sf-21794-314451" />
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]<ref name="sf-21794-328147" /><ref name="sf-21794-330547">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=330547#p330547 Wyoming States 2008!], Kizakh (Regis Michelena), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums, forum.starwarsccg.org (23 August 2008). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261125192329/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t21794.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Organization ==

Michelena, of Team Wyoming, announced the event on 11 July 2008 with the words "SWCCG returns to the Equality State!" It was held together with the [[2008 Colorado State Championship|Colorado State Championship]] on 16 August, and there were prizes for all.<ref name="sf-21794-314451" /> Fort Collins, Colorado, where the Colorado event was held, is about an hour from Laramie.<ref name="sf-21008-303347" /><ref name="sf-21794-327348" />

== Results ==

Two of the ten players dropped after the second game.<ref name="sf-21794-327348" /> Hunter went undefeated, and McGee received the bye after conceding the final confrontation.<ref name="sf-21794-328147" /> Michelena posted the final standings on 23 August 2008:<ref name="sf-21794-330547" />
